payload.reason: The evidence indicates that factors such as insolation, cloudiness, and spatial variability in precipitation and melting efficiency can influence glacier distribution, in addition to temperature and precipitation.

claims.text: Insolation and cloudiness are climate variables that influence glacier extent.
Spatial variability in precipitation due to topographic effects, such as rain shadows, affects glacier distribution.
Differences in melting efficiency across valleys can limit glacier growth and influence their distribution.
